fields.label: Feature name
fields.description: Private concise feature name, kept distinct from the value or problem statement.

fields.label: Why this matters
fields.description: Private value created or problem removed; it becomes Description and is never folded into the name.

fields.label: Why confidence
fields.description: Whether the why is confirmed or a provisional inference that must be reviewed before any create can proceed.

fields.label: Card type
fields.description: Portable body-shape classification that must also match one current board option.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: Private concise explanation written into the body Summary section.

fields.label: Type-specific behavior
fields.description: Private exact behavior, acceptance, scope, desired-state, or repro facts for the type-specific second section.

fields.label: Current state in code
fields.description: Optional private factual current-state note, including exact file references only when actually observed.

fields.label: Relationships
fields.description: Optional private exact related tool or card references; preparation never invents missing relationships.

fields.label: Decisions and open questions
fields.description: Optional private unresolved decisions or questions kept visible in the deterministic body.

fields.label: Board area
fields.description: Optional private exact Area request accepted only when the configured board currently declares it.

fields.label: Board priority
fields.description: Optional private exact Priority request accepted only when the configured board currently declares it.
